bugs.text: `G.stars=[]` is executed at script top level while G is still null (newGame() only assigns G at line 940). TypeError at load; the rest of the script (newGame, initStars, the rAF loop) never runs, so the page stays black forever. Confirmed by result.json pageerror and all-black screenshots.
Even with line 793 moved after newGame(), newGame() does not create a stars array, so initStars (796) and update (444) would throw on G.stars; a title-return via newGame would also drop the stars.
The keydown handler reads G.state unconditionally; with G null every key press throws (after initAudio runs), so neither P nor M ever work.
startDive calls G.capturedBossExists(), which is never defined. The first time a Boss Galaga is chosen to dive the update loop throws, which would stop the game mid-play.

returnUp sets state 'RETURN2' but updateEnemies has no RETURN2 case, so a boss that finished its tractor-beam hover freezes in place forever; a boss holding a captured fighter never returns to formation and never dives again, so the rescue/dual-fighter path can never happen.

drawTextC('800 WITH ONE ESCORT ...', 2, W/2, 158, '#808080') passes arguments in the wrong order (cx=2, y=112, col=158, sc='#808080'); the escort line of the score table would render as garbage or not at all.
Losing one half of the dual fighter also decrements the reserve count (G.ships--) and can trigger game over, whereas the arcade only removes that half.
Dead stubs: G_starsInit() is empty, updateBeam() is empty, and `if(e.state==='CH'&&false)continue;` is a no-op.
Sway amplitude jumps from 5 to 2.5 the instant the formation completes, producing a visible snap in the formation position.
Divers and released escorts are teleported to y=-14 the moment their path ends (even if it ends on screen) rather than visibly leaving the bottom and re-entering.

summary: The file reads like a fairly complete Galaga design: bezier entry loops with a 1.5-turn spiral, five staged entry waves matching the 4/16/20 layout, sway and breathing, aimed dives with Goei escorts and 400/800/1600 scoring, a hovering tractor beam with animated rungs and a pull-up capture, freed-fighter docking into a dual fighter, a hostile captive, challenging stages with wave bonuses, flag denominations, and a dozen synthesized sounds, all in a state/update/render layout with a proper 1/60 accumulator loop. None of it ever runs: an initialisation-order mistake at line 793 (touching G.stars before G exists) kills the script at load, so the browser shows only a black canvas and the play-test recorded zero frames. Behind that first wall sit further crashes an actual player would hit quickly (an undefined G.capturedBossExists on the first boss dive, a null G in the key handler) and a missing RETURN2 state that would strand every tractor-beam boss. The code quality is mid-level: readable names and sensible comments, but with several leftover stubs and inconsistent state names that show it was never run once before delivery. As delivered it has no Galaga feel at all because it never draws a frame.
